description: This file is a Grunt configuration script used for automating build tasks such as cleaning directories, concatenating files, minifying, compressing, copying, and generating documentation for the Footable project.

methods.name: grunt.initConfig
methods.description: Initializes the Grunt configuration with tasks for cleaning, concatenating, minifying, compressing, copying, and documentation.

methods.name: grunt.loadNpmTasks
methods.description: Loads external Grunt plugins required for various build tasks.

methods.name: grunt.registerTask
methods.description: Defines default and custom task sequences for building and packaging the project.
